mapper.insert: insert into corgi_fake_user_pool (`user_id`) select f.follow_user_id from corgi_user_follow f join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = f.follow_user_id and f.type = 'real' join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f.follow_user_id where p.uptime < #{time} and d.avatar_status is null and avatar_check_status = 'normal' group by f.follow_user_id order by count(1) limit #{size}
insert ignore into corgi_user_follow (`user_id`, `follow_user_id`, `uptime`, `type`) values ( #{userId}, #{followId}, NOW(), 'fake' );
mapper.select: select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId} and `type` = 'fake'
select count(1) from corgi_activity_like where activity_id = #{activityId} and `type` = 'fake'
select activity_id id, creator_id userId, category from corgi_activity_creator where category in ('video', 'image') and ctime >= #{time}
select ctime from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId} and type = 'fake' order by id desc limit 1
